notes.title: Coming next: A new character, weapon and map in the next big update
notes.content:
Hi ninja,

It has been a while since the last time we post the dev log. Today, I'm glad to share some news to let you know what's coming next. 

As the title said，the new update would include a new playable character and a new weapon.
Here is a screenshot of our new character with the new dual-wielding weapons. Since we don't have any dual-wielding weapons before, we decide to add one as our new weapon. This weapon attack style would be fast and quick with better VFX. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/30cdc485fd0dc85b7bfe4adde7e8ba1606d1286c.png[/img]
We actually also improve all of our weapons' VFX at the same time. You can try once the new update is released.

The new map, there are many stories I can share with you about how I create that. But in short, the map will 1:1 restore the actual castle in Japan: Nijo Castle. 

Although the castles in the game do exist in history, most of them have disappeared, or only the castle basement walls remain. Nijo Castle is different from them, and its overall preservation is perfect, and it is still one of the famous scenic spots in Kyoto.
After carefully collecting information and evaluating the feasibility, we decided to try to restore the structure of Nijo Castle 1:1 in the game. Afterward, we can make some adjustments according to the needs of the gameplay.

Here are some contrast screenshots we made during our development.
You might notice the new map is in the day scene. Because the previous levels were all night, we wanted to make this unique map a daytime scene.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/bd797eb770055a8170226df233158131eaeaee89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/2a1c9172d43e4a0d2cde367dc023fd78f29dc5a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/42f84c10d0e8fc55a4a261c3b9f181bc7024e718.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/a801971c5b66729533f993912b66259309f52b28.png[/img]


In the next update, we also add full controller support and other improvements. I will post another blog about the latest version in detail once all things have been done. As always, if you have any questions or suggestions, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.

notes.title: Details we added in the next update
notes.content:
Hi ninjas, 
The new update is coming soon. Instead of a very long dev update log,  I'd like to share something special today: details we added in the update. 
These things are not being spotted usually but developing them is quite interesting. So I feel it would be an excellent chance to write a little log to introduce some of them.

[b]Hit animation based on the direction and the weapon length.[/b]
Instead of randomly playing hit animation, we add a system that characters will play hit animation based on the attack direction. Also, a long-length weapon will push the player further.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/2288c2b32efabd7b4e8d1c8b747ca3afbdd63959.gif[/img]
In fact, not just animation, we also upgrade our sound effects to make the whole combat feels better.

[b]New 2D art[/b]
The older UI elements are way too simple, which makes the game look very pool. We now update them with higher quality. Let's use a new map as an example. 
(Translated names on the map will update once we prepared the translation sheet)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/2c527ccf8f29c8825f3fbc91f73442c75965bcb0.jpg[/img]

[b]Pond fish[/b]
A pond without any fish is kind of boring, right? Let's add them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/43cf4ff176593eb007df759507e3bc0e399b81f9.gif[/img]

[b]Sounds detail[/b]
sounds are always important to create a vivid world. We added some extra sounds where we missed in the past. For example, you now can hear the pig snort when you approach them.
[b]
More smooth gameplay[/b]
There are some tiny functions we didn't add in the older version. They might not affect the primary gameplay system, but adding them will surely help the gameplay more smoothly. As an example, the "press to skip" function when playing the intro dialog. 

That's all for today. Hope you like them. As always, if you have any questions or suggestions, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.

notes.title: What's coming in the next new big update
notes.content:
Hello Ninjas,

It's been a long time since the last time we post the blog. Some players even think we abandon this project. But in fact, we are just too busy these days working on the new update. Sorry about didn't update more info to let you guys know the progress. Since we almost finished the new big update, I feel it's time to show you guys what's coming next. 

[b]The new update contains new levels, a new combat system, a new male character, and much more. [/b] Let's talk about them one by one.

First, [b]three new levels are coming in the next update[/b].  Each of them will have a unique environment and story background. After playing all of them, you will find the storyline makes more sense.  There is a screenshot of the level we are developing. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/2c92c776305d3bfa6711887b7a59929ccc2ec181.png[/img]


Next, [b]we updated our combat system[/b]. Instead of just polishing details, we add a brand new design for the combat. Players are now able to choose the different styles and combine them into their own attack combo.  For example, there are nine styles for katana in total (yes, we will add new katana as a weapon to choose from). You can use katana01, 05, 09 as your attack combo. If you like one style special, you can even make your combo be like"katana01, 01, 01". We are currently designing the UI element for this new system. So we will post the new screenshot for this system in the next update blog. 

Also, [b]about characters[/b], we add a new male ninja, and also the customizable hat and mask we mentioned before is implemented. The new character can both use Kanata and wakizashi (Japanese: 脇差, "side inserted [sword]").

We also [b]add some other little systems and update in the game[/b]. For example, we add a panel to show all the items you have received and another panel to show how much progress you have achieved in different nindo. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/5a023dd703906d42fa0fbb99af1973b60f911897.png[/img]

That's all we want to share with you today. Hope you like these updates. We plan to add them to the test branch by the middle of April. And the official release of the update by the end of April.

notes.title: Patch note v0.1.2
notes.content:
Hello Ninja,

The map info system is now available.

Use the [b]"M"[/b] key to open the map.
This system currently does not support the controller yet; we will add that in the future update.

As discussed in the previous blog, the map system can record the main information that players have found. For example, if you have chatted with the doctor at the first level, the map will show this place as the doctor's home. Then next time you want to buy the medicine for the merchant, you can check the map to locate the doctor. Also, the map will show that the merchant needs medicine after you talked with him.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/0bb322cf2c82683bd109cbeaf25153f817096148.jpg[/img]

We also made some other minor updates, such as new crouch animation.

That's all for this update. We are currently working on the new stealth and battle system, which might take a longer time than the map system since it's a bigger update. As always, if you have any questions or suggestions, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.

notes.title: System update plan
notes.content:
Hello ninja，

Thank you so much for buying this game at the current EA stage and for all the feedback. 
According to the feedback we got, there are two main problems: the battle/stealth system is too simple.
Lack of clues record function.
so we are planning to add the following updates in the future:

1. battle system/stealth system
Add a stealth system like Tenchu 3.
Many people talk about missing Tenchu and be disappointed when our game system is far away from it. Don't worry. We are now working on it!
We will update the stealth and battle system fellow Tenchu 3 (Which is my personal favorite in the Tenchu series). You can expect systems such as wall covering, grappling hook, and so on. With the system update, the map design will also need adjustment. 
Update time: 
We plan to update the system in about two weeks. After that, we will adjust the map design.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38056407/5b90221f1c6b0c3131e740e5c755fee35dfde782.png[/img]

2. Map info system
For now, players have to remember all the info and clues by themself. We will add a new Map info system to record all the information that players have found. For example, if you have chatted with the doctor at the first level, the map will show this place as the doctor's home. Then next time you want to buy the medicine for the merchant, you can just check the map to locate the doctor. Also, the map will show that the merchant needs medicine after you talked with him.
Update time:
The map info system should be ready within one week. 

That's all I got today. As always, if you have any questions or suggestions, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.
I wish you the best, and good luck.
